import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    # take the first token if there are spaces
    if ' ' in line:
        line = line.split()[0]
    result = 0
    last = 1
    for i in range(1, len(line)):
        if line[i] == line[i-1]:
            last += 1
        else:
            if last % 2 == 0:
                result += 1
            last = 1
    if last % 2 == 0:
        result += 1
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
